description:
Update a saved screener's name, query, schedule, or baseline symbols.

    Args:
        screener_id: The screener UUID from list_screeners
        name: New name (optional)
        query: Updated filter blob (optional)
        schedule: "off", "daily", or "weekly" (optional; weekly requires Pro)
        notify_on_change: Toggle enter/exit notifies (optional)
        last_symbols: Refresh enter/exit baseline from the live table (optional)

strategy_id.description: Strategy this call belongs to. UUID from list_strategies. The card this call writes keeps that id. Omit when the call is not part of a strategy.
strategy_id.title: Strategy Id

name: update_screener
title: Update screener
